## Setup required — inactive export
Create a dedicated Telegram API credential and select it on Telegram Trigger and Telegram Send. No credential references or secrets are included. Confirm HTTPS WEBHOOK_URL, localhost core connectivity and smoke assertions, then activate explicitly. Trigger v1.3 authenticates webhook requests with a generated secret token and drops pending updates on activation. Private human chats only. Execution payload saving disabled (including manual/error); do not pin or log real GPS. Radius is 10 km straight-line to nearest known station; edit maxNearestKm in Metro Data or generator then regenerate. Lines 1 and 2 are supported (line 2: headway-based, phase unmeasured). Coordinates are not walking routes. Activation remains outstanding in this export.
